alternatives.escape_requires: VMM or KVM bug after guest compromise
alternatives.name: Firecracker microVM
alternatives.sandlock_difference: no image, no root, ~20x faster start, plus HTTP-level egress policy a VM cannot express

alternatives.escape_requires: Sentry bug or a host bug reachable through it
alternatives.name: gVisor
alternatives.sandlock_difference: host kernel stays in the syscall path; native performance and full compatibility, wider escape surface

alternatives.name: Containers (namespaces + cgroups)
alternatives.sandlock_difference: access-control ruleset rather than a constructed namespace; no image; HTTP ACL; CoW rollback

alternatives.name: bubblewrap / firejail
alternatives.sandlock_difference: no user-namespace requirement; destination-IP and HTTP rules; credential injection; transactional writes

alternatives.name: Raw Landlock + seccomp
alternatives.sandlock_difference: the supervisor, the CoW engine, the HTTP layer, the protection-posture model and the distribution - i.e. every hard part

alternatives.name: OpenShell (NVIDIA)
alternatives.sandlock_difference: OpenShell requires Docker/Podman/microVM/K8s underneath; sandlock is the confinement itself. They compose rather than compete

note: Compared on isolation boundary and failure mode, not on a feature matrix.
